description:
Gap surfaced by the PR #192 cold audit (F2): a materializer worker can survive with a durable materializers/<tag> entry and a registered, monitorable name while never having been locked into the CURRENT epoch (e.g. an ambiguous publish timeout left it running, or a node rejoined after recovery re-adopted around it). The distributor's assignment monitor finds a live process, so death healing never fires — but the worker is not pulling for this epoch and the tag is effectively unavailable until the next recovery.

Direction options: a sweep-time adoption probe (ask the monitored worker which epoch it is unlocked into; mismatch → heal exactly like a death), or read-path evidence (repeated coverage_failed/:locked shed for a covered tag escalates to a heal). Either must respect the verdict-before-destruction rule: probing is a READ; only an unambiguous not-adopted answer may displace the entry.
title: Heal alive-but-unadopted materializers: liveness is not adoption
